instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/outer_plate.step in FreeCAD 0.21.2. For this task, open the part in FreeCAD from `/usr/bin/freecad`, then carry out the Path workbench edits. Use the actual supplied 120 x 80 x 12 mm solid, whose source STEP bounds are X=-60..60 mm, Y=-40..40 mm, and Z=0..12 mm. Create one native Path/CAM Job and set G54 at the part top-face center. Keep the stock top and bottom coincident with the part in Z and choose reasonable nonnegative X/Y side stock. In this work coordinate system the part top is Z=0 and the source bottom Z=0.000 mm is WCS Z=-12.000 mm. Use T1, a native 6 mm flat end mill, at S9000 rpm and horizontal cutting feed F650 mm/min; choose a safe positive vertical feed and positive safe/clearance heights. First create an active native outside rough Profile with cutter compensation and 0.2 mm OffsetExtra, using any reasonable positive stepdown to reach WCS Z=-12.000 mm. Then create a separate active native outside finish Profile with cutter compensation and 0.0 mm OffsetExtra; this second operation must make one final full-depth contour at WCS Z=-12.000 mm. Verify both toolpaths, then post the Job with FreeCAD's native linuxcnc or grbl postprocessor. Save the editable native Job and its matching posted program at exactly /home/user/Desktop/task-2.FCStd and /home/user/Desktop/task-2.nc.
